evidence: The portable sqlite-wal-v1 profile and runtime pin the exact 61e5693187250e240f9b6cae573e3b89752ae9b135c6c739d14ff3dfbf6dfdc9 DDL fingerprint and exact 24-trigger immutable-row inventory.

Project/schema identity, aggregate identity, aggregate revisions, all normalized kind-extension rows, versioned settings, and provenance are insert-only under direct database denial triggers. Canonical-connection hostile tests reject valid replacement values and deletion, not merely malformed data.

Object availability/verification metadata and outbox delivery metadata remain the only intentionally mutable version-1 row classes; pending NULL timestamps and their governed state transitions are covered directly.
Foreign keys, STRICT typing, project ownership, kind relationships, UTC timestamps, WAL reader/writer behavior, and bounded writer waiting remain passing without storing arbitrary derived blobs.
Focused tests deny UPDATE/DELETE for every immutable row class and deny ordinary canonical SQL from dropping the protecting triggers.
The original hostile UUID/timestamp/kind/FK/setting, existing-file, hardlink, mismatch, ATTACH, forged-schema, and project lifecycle boundary tests remain passing.

Two consecutive clean governed performance qualifications pass the unchanged reviewed thresholds. An earlier retained run produced one nonqualifying fresh p95 of 24.282 ms due to two workstation outliers; the subsequent raw distributions are retained and disclosed rather than replacing the baseline.
ADR-0014, the architecture guide, and the portable storage contract now distinguish immutable history from intentionally mutable object/outbox state and bind the exact trigger inventory.

Ordinary canonical connections deny schema-changing SQL. CAP-02.S02.T02 must introduce a separate, tightly scoped backup-first migration connection that replaces governed DDL and publishes a successor fingerprint; this task does not pre-implement or bypass migration authority.

No UI, dependency, repository layer, encryption, secret-management, or unrelated runtime scope was added. Broader migration/repository/backup/recovery qualification remains assigned to the rest of the approved slice and W1 campaign.
